finding: Retained Boolean-power structure can be repaired across edits; savings depend on propagation and subsequent use. Maintaining unused powers can lose badly.
limitations: Declared work-event accounting on selected small graphs, not CPU/energy measurements or a universal speedup.
Python 3.10 or later, standard library. The original command overwrites results.json; use a disposable extracted copy for any separately requested replay.
